notes: the report has no transmitter: it opens with the question «وَ سَأَلَ مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ» and the Imam's answer follows (rule 10), so the Imam is the single link
the asker Musa b. Bakr is not a link, since the report is the Imam's answer (rule 5)
the earlier report (1146) is not taken over: this report does not open with «عنه» or «بهذا الإسناد»
